violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager (CFM) present at the beginning of the inspection. Observed no CFM on site at the start of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived prior to the end of the inspection. EHS discussed need for CFM to be on site.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at expo is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Observed no water flow at hand sink due to water being turned off.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC turned water valve on to allow water to flow to hand sink.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink being used to store cans of sweetened condensed milk.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed cans from hand sink.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the chlorine sanitizer solution was measured at 200+ ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. PIC remade sanitizer to appropriate concentration of 100 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of chlorine solution between 50-100 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. EHS discussed proper chlorine sanitizer concentration requirements with PIC. Please use chlorine test strips to verify concentration of sanitizer prior to use.

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed prescription medication, ‘Tylenol,’ ‘Advil,’ and an inhaler stored directly on counter used for food preparation.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC relocated medicines away from food preparation area. EHS discussed need to designate a medication storage area away from food preparation area with PIC.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at three compartment sink handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC provided hand cleanser.

violations.title: Food Not from Private Home
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is prepared in a private home, an unapproved food source, is distributed or offered for sale to the public: yogurt
violations.corrective_action: Food prepared in a private home may NOT be used or offered for human consumption in a food establishment. PIC removed yogurt made in private home from establishment.

violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC placed medicine in designated storage.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Observed 3 compartment sink temperature at 107F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC contacted certified plumber during inspection. PIC will provide EHS with invoice and verification of water temperature once service has been completed.
